title: Parsley Health coverage section
description: An ivory section about insurance: eyebrow, light serif title, two paragraphs and two stacked pills (forest fill, forest outline) on the left, and a 2×4 wall of insurer names set as plain dark wordmarks on the right. On phones everything centres and the name wall moves up under the title.
notes: insurer names are plain text in three styles (serif, sans, italic) standing in for logos
